However, two physical inconsistencies prevent a perfect score: (1) Contact physics between trucks and elephant back lack realistic weight deformation—the heavy wooden trucks should compress the skin slightly and cast deeper occlusion shadows at tire-skin interfaces; instead they appear minimally grounded. These are severity-2 artifacts that reduce authenticity but do not compromise overall coherence. The green elephant texture, while intentionally non-natural, maintains wrinkle detail consistency without appearing like a flat overlay.
